parsed.self_critique_fixed: The script has been successfully localized into natural, conversational, and highly code-mixed Romanized Hindi (Hinglish). The hook opens with a native Hindi phrase ('Mujhe saans lene mein...') to ensure a high thumbstop rate. Polite registers are carefully maintained: Ramesh and Dr. Arjun address each other with respectful 'aap' forms, and Miss Nova uses warm, polite plural commands ('karein'). Product vocabulary and daily English terms are kept in English as per the Stay-English list (T2). No brand-safety violations or hard pricing constraints were present in the comments.

violations.why: The simulated app store installation pop-up and 'Installing...' text constitute a fake UI/misleading mechanic, which violates Meta's ad policies.
violations.fix: Replace the simulated installation progress and 'Installing...' text with a static App Store/Google Play badge.
